parameters.query:
SELECT alignment_run_id::text AS alignment_run_id, voiceover_id::text AS voiceover_id, language_code, narration, audio_sha256, audio_duration_ms, scenes_json
FROM factory.begin_alignment($1::uuid);

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ language_code: $json.language_code, narration: $json.narration, audio_sha256: $json.audio_sha256, audio_duration_ms: $json.audio_duration_ms, scenes: (typeof $json.scenes_json === 'string' ? JSON.parse($json.scenes_json) : $json.scenes_json) }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT alignment_id::text AS alignment_id, scene_timing_count, lexical_end_ms
FROM factory.complete_alignment($1::uuid, $2::jsonb);
